name: Stanford Spring 2011
information: Registration will be $5 for the first event, $2 for each additional event. $1 of each competitor's fee will go to the WCA. Competitors may pre-register for the competition until May 18. Competitors who do not pre-register can register at the door for an additional $5 fee.rnrnStanford: Stanford community members may compete for free and are encouraged to help run the competition (even if they did not pre-register).
